gates.meaning: The operation object is the environmental instrument at its own RS485 address. A direct child address and a gateway remap offset are distinct bindings.
The operation object is the attached meter. Use its established logical/RS485 address; this is not the gateway-self table.
The meter preamble defines positive power as feed to grid and negative power as supply from grid.
These are gateway-supplied child-associated aliases, not proof that the child natively implements the same register map.
Public connection status: 0xB000 disconnected; 0xB001 online. This is separate from remapped inverter status 0xC000 uploading.
Device display name is limited to 20 bytes excluding the terminator, within visible ASCII 0x20–0x7E.
The name constraint explicitly excludes apostrophe, double quote and backslash.
Gateway-self Unit ID is 0. Aggregate plant fields retain their row-specific equipment scope.
The public-register table does not specify this list counter route. Reported self-unit 0 success and child exception 3 are operator observations, not vendor routing rules.
Access is on the SmartLogger endpoint; the child physical address and target kind determine the block. Inverter and environmental offsets are not interchangeable.
Source formula: 51000 + 25 × (child physical address − 1) + offset. The source describes contiguous physical numbering to avoid wasted blocks.

Applicability conflict: the preamble names inverter support only, while the same section includes an environmental-monitor offset table. Preserve that table as a source layout; its environmental applicability remains unresolved against the narrower preamble.

High-precision charging capability is the minimum of two sums on a shared DC bus: adjustable PCS charging power from grid-connected or power-limited-shutdown PCSs; and battery-pack chargeable power from packs operating in DCDC mode. Retain three decimal places.

Low-precision charging capability is the minimum of two sums on a shared DC bus: adjustable PCS charging power from grid-connected or power-limited-shutdown PCSs; and battery-pack chargeable power from packs operating in DCDC mode. Retain one decimal place.
Accumulated positive-direction active energy reported by the grid meter. The source's redundant meter wording does not redefine the directional convention.
The grid-meter reverse-direction quantity is described here as active power. Preserve that wording alongside the bound row's energy name/unit if they disagree; do not silently change power to energy.
Accumulated load consumption = accumulated generation − accumulated sales + accumulated purchases − accumulated absorption.
Accumulated absorption is summed across all inverter/PCS AC outputs.

Rated capacity is the CMU aggregate plus the distributed-ESS aggregate. The source calls this rated power capacity; interpret it together with the exact row unit.

Real-time control SOC is aggregated at plant level using BCU-reported cluster SOC, SOH and rated capacity. Include array clusters except disconnected or shut-down clusters, also excluding those with disconnected or shut-down DCDC links. Exclude an entire DC bus's clusters when all PCSs on that bus are shut down, disconnected or locked. Capacity is expressed in Ah and SOC in %; the source calls the Ah quantity energy. This control calculation has a different scope from display SOC.
Plant-level battery SOH aggregate.
Plant-level battery SOE aggregate.
Plant-level aggregate rated battery capacity in Ah.
Input-power total across all inverters.
Aggregate inverter CO2 reduction. Use signal 40550 when the total exceeds U32 representation.
Active-output total across all inverters.

Real-time display SOC has range [0, 100]. It uses BCU-reported cluster SOC, SOH and rated capacity, and includes array clusters either operating or in commanded shutdown. Capacity is in Ah and SOC in %; the source calls the Ah quantity energy. This cell does not repeat the control-SOC DC-bus exclusions.
Chargeable capacity sums non-faulted clusters whose bus has non-faulted PCSs; both eligibility conditions apply.

Emergency-control lockout bits: bit 0 active power; bit 1 reactive power. Both use 0 unlocked and 1 locked. Bits 2–15 are reserved. Preserve lockout wording rather than equating it to every override field.

Grid/island aggregate dictionary: 0 grid operation; 2 mixed operation with the islanded share below 50%; 3 mixed operation with the islanded share at least 50%; 0xFF invalid. Code 3 is printed twice with the same meaning, and code 1 is not assigned. No missing state is invented.

controls.condition: Only payload 0 is permitted. SmartLogger relays startup signals to every inverter, ESS and PCS in the array.
Only payload 0 is permitted. SmartLogger relays shutdown signals to every inverter, ESS and PCS in the array.
Array-wide command: 0 power-off; 1 power-on. SmartLogger forwards it to every inverter, ESS and PCS in the array.
Array-wide command: 0 power-off; 1 power-on. SmartLogger forwards it to every inverter, ESS and PCS in the array.
State 0 means operating; 1 means unavailable because of a fault. Fault shutdown prevents a response to startup requests.
Active-power interval: 0 through the array's combined inverter rated active power, inclusive. This cell does not itself state an out-of-range action.
Active-power interval: minus to plus the array's combined PCS rated active power. This cell does not itself state an out-of-range action.
The printed interval uses positive combined inverter rated apparent power for both endpoints. A negative lower endpoint is absent; preserve this source conflict rather than inserting a minus sign.

The cell repeats the subarray's combined PCS rated apparent power twice, without an explicit sign, interval delimiter or execution rule. A signed range cannot be recovered unambiguously from this text.

Sets aggregate connected inverter/PCS active output and discards out-of-range values. The printed lower bound is positive combined PCS rated active power and the upper bound is combined inverter-plus-PCS rated active power; no minus sign is printed before the lower bound. Preserve this edition's unresolved bound conflict.
Sets aggregate inverter/PCS reactive output. The interval is minus to plus combined inverter-and-PCS rated apparent power; out-of-range dispatch values are discarded.
Sets aggregate active output of the inverters attached to the data collector. This cell names inverters without adding PCS scope.
Sets aggregate reactive output of the inverters attached to the data collector. This cell names inverters without adding PCS scope.
Allowed power-factor interval: (−1, −0.8] ∪ [0.8, 1]. The −1 endpoint is excluded.

The printed active-power interval begins at positive combined PCS rated active power and ends at combined inverter-plus-PCS rated active power. No negative lower-bound sign is present; do not import one from another edition.
Reactive-power interval: minus to plus the combined inverter-and-PCS rated apparent power.
Requests a data-collector reset; the payload is not checked.

Allowed interval: [0, 200000]. This is not the 2000000 upper bound printed in other editions.
